Management Plan
- management_plan_main: 
  - Arrange face-to-face ear examination with a GP within 4–5 days to inspect the left ear (otoscopy) and exclude physical blockage (e.g., wax) or identify other causes
  - If wax blockage is found, perform removal; if not, proceed to further evaluation of potential inner-ear/balance issues
  - Provide tinnitus information leaflet to patient prior to appointment
  - Advise patient to avoid cotton buds for ear cleaning
  - If any issues arise before the appointment, book another appointment or a video consult
  - Admin to slot the patient into the clinic; notes from this visit will be available to the attending GP
